appDescription.message: Verifiable capture and preservation of digital evidence.

betaNoImmutability.message: No immutability or Object Lock guarantee.

homeBody.message: Create an integral, traceable package with context, sequence, and technical proof.

newEvidenceHint.message: Record this tab from start to finish

verifyPackageBody.message: Select a ZIP to calculate its SHA-256 locally without uploading the file.

fullVerificationNotice.message: Complete signature, chain, and receipt validation is performed by the offline verifier included in the project.

settingsBody.message: The language follows Chrome. Endpoints and retention are defined by the deployed environment.

loginBody.message: Enter your email. We will send a single-use link; no code or token is included in capture logs.

accessLinkSent.message: Check your email, open the link, and return here. This screen will detect access automatically.

newCaptureBody.message: Chitãozinho records video, images, page structure, visible text, and metadata, linking everything to the capture sequence.

prepareContext.message: Start on the page that identifies the content and its source.

prepareNavigation.message: Browse calmly and show dates, profiles, addresses, and relevant context.

prepareFinish.message: Finish in Chitãozinho to generate and download the evidence package.

sensitiveDataNotice.message: Only record content you are authorized to collect. Take extra care with sensitive data and third-party information.

captureConsent.message: I confirm that I am authorized to record this content and want to start collecting it.

discardCaptureConfirmation.message: Discard this capture's local buffer? The partial record already sent to the server will be preserved. This action cannot be undone.

partialCapture.message: This capture is partial. The package will record each unavailable item and its reason.

captureComplete.message: The package was saved to your downloads folder and is ready to preserve or verify.

capturePreserved.message: Your capture remains saved on this device whenever recovery is possible.

errorNoTab.message: Open a regular browser tab and try starting the capture again.

errorStateChanged.message: The capture state changed. Reopen the extension to see the available actions.

errorConnection.message: The service could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.

errorUpload.message: Part of the capture could not be recorded. Try resuming or finalizing again.

errorUnexpected.message: This action could not be completed. Try again.
